entity.readOnly: You can view this, but only {who} can change it.

institute.title: Institute
institute.subtitle: Your institute’s name and details, shown on every timetable.
institute.name: Institute name
institute.affiliationHint: Leave empty if your institute is a university or autonomous without affiliation.
institute.logoLater: Uploading a logo comes with Excel import, later in setup.

departments.title: Departments
departments.subtitle: Teaching departments own branches and sections. Service departments, like Applied Sciences, teach other departments’ students.
departments.name: Name
departments.empty: No departments yet. Add your first one.

programmes.title: Programmes
programmes.subtitle: B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA … and their branches. Branches belong to departments.
programmes.name: Name
programmes.lateralHint: Leave empty if there is no lateral entry. B.Tech LEET usually joins in semester 3.
programmes.hasBranchesHint: Untick for programmes like MBA or BCA; one branch is made for you.
programmes.departmentHint: Leave as “Whole institute” for programmes that span departments, like B.Tech.
programmes.empty: No programmes yet. Start from a common programme above.

schemes.title: Schemes and courses
schemes.subtitle: Each batch follows one study scheme. Several schemes can run at once.
schemes.name: Name
schemes.courseCount: {count, plural, =0 {no courses yet} one {# course} other {# courses}}
schemes.empty: No schemes yet. Add the scheme your batches follow, e.g. Scheme 2024.

courses.title: {programme} · {scheme}
courses.subtitle: Courses per semester with L-T-P. Credits are L + T + P/2 unless you change them.
courses.creditsHint: Leave empty to use L + T + P/2.
courses.electiveGroupHint: Courses in the same group run at the same time, e.g. Elective-IV.
courses.offeringDepartmentHint: Applied Sciences for Maths, even in a CSE scheme.
courses.branchesHint: Pick none if the course is common to every branch.
courses.labCategoryHint: e.g. Software lab or Hardware lab. Must match a room’s lab category.
courses.isScheduledHint: Untick for MOOCs, training and project-only courses.
courses.weekTotal: {periods} periods a week for all of this semester’s courses, all branches together.

terms.title: Sessions and terms
terms.subtitle: A session (2026-27) has an odd term (July–Dec) and an even term (Jan–June). One term is current.
terms.label: Label
terms.minTeachingDaysHint: Usually 90. Shown as a warning when the calendar falls short.
terms.statusHint: Only one term can be current. Close it before promoting batches.
terms.runningHint: Worked out from the programmes. Batches get their semester from their admission year.
terms.windowsHint: First year and lateral entry often start later and have their own exam dates.
terms.semestersHint: e.g. 1 or 3, 5, 7. Empty means every semester.
terms.noWindows: No start dates yet. Everyone starts on the term’s first day.
terms.cohortsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No cohorts in this term yet.} one {# cohort in this term.} other {# cohorts in this term.}}
terms.generateHint: Makes a cohort for every studying batch whose semester runs this term. Safe to run again.
terms.generated: {created, plural, =0 {No new cohorts.} one {# cohort created.} other {# cohorts created.}} {existing} already there, {notRunning} not running this term.
terms.promoteNeedsClosed: When this term ends, close it to move every batch up one semester into the next term.
terms.rowExists: {code} is already in the next term
terms.rowJoins: Sits in the regular sections, as now.
terms.rowReviewCode: check the code; the year changes
terms.promoted: {created} cohorts created, {graduated} batches finished, {skipped} left as they were.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Holidays, exam weeks and working Saturdays for {term}.
calendar.noTermBody: The calendar belongs to a term.
calendar.noHolidays: No holidays in this term yet.
calendar.pasteHint: One per line: date, name. For several days: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-10, Diwali break.
calendar.pasteResult: {count, plural, =0 {No holidays added.} one {# holiday added.} other {# holidays added.}}
calendar.windowsHint: Mid-semester exams, orientation and vacations are not teaching days.
calendar.addWindow: Add an exam week or break
calendar.extraDaysHint: Extra teaching days that follow a weekday’s timetable, to make up lost days.
calendar.followsWeekdayHint: Rotate weekdays so no subject falls behind.

bell.title: Bell schedules
bell.subtitle: Periods and breaks of the day. The default one is used unless a programme has its own.
bell.editorHint: Fill evenly sized periods, then adjust any period. Lunch and other breaks go between periods.
bell.name: Name
bell.isDefault: Use for everyone unless a programme has its own
bell.usedByHint: Only if they differ from the default (e.g. first year).

batches.title: Batches
batches.subtitle: Students admitted to a branch in one year. Each batch follows one scheme.
batches.admissionYearHint: Lateral entry: the year they joined (in semester 3).
batches.schemeHint: The study scheme this batch follows.

cohorts.title: Cohorts and sections
cohorts.subtitle: Each batch in {term}: its semester, sections and sub-groups.
cohorts.noTermBody: Cohorts are batches in a term.
cohorts.empty: No cohorts in this term yet.
cohorts.line: Semester {semester} · admitted {year} · {sections, plural, =0 {no sections yet} one {# section} other {# sections}} · {students} students
cohorts.joinsLine: Semester {semester} · sits in the sections of {host}
cohorts.joinsExplain: These lateral-entry students sit in the sections of {host}. Count them in those sections’ strength.
cohorts.displayCodeHint: Shown in timetables, e.g. D2 CSE.
cohorts.semesterHint: Worked out from the admission year. Change only if this batch is out of step.
cohorts.isRunningHint: Untick for an industrial training or internship semester.
cohorts.joinsHint: Lateral-entry students usually join the regular sections.
cohorts.sectionsTotal: {count, plural, =0 {No sections} one {# section} other {# sections}}, {students} students.
cohorts.subGroupsHint: For labs and tutorials. Students are split evenly; change it later.
cohorts.doesNotAddUp: Sub-groups add up to {sum}, but the section has {total}.
cohorts.electivesHint: Students who chose the same elective, from one or more sections.
cohorts.fromSectionsHint: Open electives can take students from other branches.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Optional for now: section strengths are enough to plan a timetable.
students.optional: Add students later from your roll lists (Excel import comes next).
students.name: Name

faculty.title: Faculty
faculty.subtitle: Teachers, their departments, how many periods they can teach, and when they are free.
faculty.name: Name
faculty.shortCodeHint: Initials shown in timetables, e.g. VT.
faculty.alsoTeachesHint: Other departments whose students they teach.
faculty.loadHint: Usual limits: experienced {exDay}/day and {exWeek}/week; freshers {frDay}/day and {frWeek}/week.
faculty.bulkBlankKeeps: Leave a box empty to keep each person’s current value.
faculty.blocked: {count, plural, one {# period blocked} other {# periods blocked}}

availability.subtitle: Periods marked “Off” are never used for this person’s classes.
availability.mySubtitle: Tap the periods you cannot teach. Your department uses this when making the timetable.
availability.notLinkedTitle: Your login isn’t linked to a faculty record yet
availability.notLinkedBody: Ask your department or institute admin to link your email to your faculty record.
availability.howTo: Tap a period to mark it Off; tap again to free it.
availability.readOnly: You can view this but not change it.
availability.noBell: Set up the bell schedule first.
availability.caption: Availability of {name}
availability.saved: Saved. {count, plural, =0 {Free every period.} one {# period off.} other {# periods off.}}

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.subtitle: Lecture rooms, labs and halls with their seats. Capacity is rows × seats per row.
rooms.buildingLine: {floors, plural, one {# floor} other {# floors}} · {rooms, plural, =0 {no rooms} one {# room} other {# rooms}}
rooms.noBuildings: No buildings yet. Add one before adding rooms.
rooms.labCategoriesHint: Comma separated, e.g. Software lab, Hardware lab.
rooms.capacityHint: Leave empty to use rows × seats per row.
rooms.isAccessibleHint: Ground floor or reachable by lift.

setup.title: Set up your institute
setup.subtitle: Twelve short steps, in the order a timetable needs them. Save and stop any time; everything stays editable later.
setup.allDone: Every step is done or skipped. You can still change anything from the menu.
setup.attentionHint: Fix these before making a timetable.
setup.attentionNone: Nothing needs your attention right now.

attention.no_active_term: No current term. Add the term you are planning and mark it current.
attention.no_cohorts: {count, plural, one {# batch has} other {# batches have}} no cohort in the current term yet.
attention.cohorts_without_sections: {count, plural, one {# cohort has} other {# cohorts have}} no sections yet.

setup.later: Arrives with the teaching grid and readiness check.
setup.editLater: You can change this later in
setup.saveFailed: We couldn’t save your progress. Please try again.
setup.needTermBody: This step belongs to a term. Add the term you are planning in the term step, then come back.
setup.schemesCourses: Open a scheme to add its courses per semester. You can add courses later too.
setup.batchesHint: One batch per branch and admission year (and lateral entry). Each follows a scheme.
setup.cohortsHint: Create the term's cohorts from the batches, then add sections to each.
setup.fixedSlotsLater: Fixed slots (mentoring, library, sports) come with the teaching grid.
setup.sampleHint: Explore a complete, fictional college before entering your own: departments, schemes, sections, 44 teachers, rooms and a calendar. It is a separate institute; your data is not touched.
setup.sampleReady: Your sample institute is ready. Its data loads in a few seconds.
setup.sampleSignIn: It has its own address, so sign in there with the same email.
setup.sampleFailed: We couldn’t create the sample institute. Please try again.

profile.title: Institute profile
profile.hint: Your institute's name, type and time zone.

cohorts.summary: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# batch} other {# batches}}

rooms.title: Buildings and rooms

rooms.summary: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# room} other {# rooms}}

bell.hint: Periods and breaks of the day. Pre-filled with the usual day; change only what differs.

calendar.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No holidays yet} one {# holiday} other {# holidays}}

teaching.title: Who teaches what
teaching.hint: Pick a teacher for each course and section.
teaching.laterBody: The teaching grid (who teaches each course to each section and sub-group) is being built. Skip this step for now; it will appear here.

ready.title: Ready to generate?
ready.hint: Check everything a timetable needs and choose which cohorts to include.
ready.laterBody: The readiness check is being built. When it is ready, this step will list anything missing and link to the screen that fixes it.

imports.title: Import from Excel
imports.subtitle: Bring in the sheets you already have. Download a template or upload your own file: we match the columns, show any problems in plain words, and import only when everything looks right.
imports.kindsHeading: What do you want to import?
imports.orderHint: Import in this order, so each sheet can refer to the ones before it.

programmes.title: Programmes and branches
programmes.hint: B.Tech with its branches, MBA, BCA …

courses.title: Courses (scheme)
courses.hint: Each semester’s courses with L-T-P and credits.

batches_sections.title: Batches and sections
batches_sections.hint: Sections of each batch this term, with strength.

students.title: Students
students.hint: The roll list, placed in sections and lab groups.

faculty.title: Faculty
faculty.hint: Teachers with designation, department and load.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.hint: The holiday list, for the whole institute or one department.

teaching_assignments.title: Teaching assignments
teaching_assignments.hint: Who teaches which course to which section (subject distribution).

imports.termRequired: Sections and teaching assignments are for one term.
imports.termOptional: Only needed to put students in sections.
imports.needTerm: Add a term on the Sessions and terms page first.
imports.fileHint: .xlsx or .csv, up to 5 MB. Your own column names are fine; we match them.
imports.reading: Reading {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}. This page updates by itself.
imports.committingBody: Importing. This page updates by itself.
imports.mappingHint: We could not find every column we need. For each one, pick the column of your file that holds it.
imports.commit: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to import} one {Import # row} other {Import # rows}}
imports.commitBlocked: {count, plural, one {Fix or skip the row with a problem first.} other {Fix or skip the # rows with problems first.}}
imports.commitHint: Everything is imported together: if one row cannot be saved, nothing changes.
imports.doneBody: {created} new, {updated} changed, {unchanged} with no change, {skipped} skipped.
imports.failedTitle: This file could not be imported
imports.cancelledBody: This import was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
imports.notAllowed: Only institute admins, heads of department and timetable coordinators can import.
imports.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
